# Claude Code Architecture

Claude Code is one program that runs a loop.
You give it a task, it asks a model what to do, it runs tools, and it repeats until the task is done.
Settings, hooks, plugins, skills, MCP servers, and subagents are layers around this loop, and you can change each of them.

## Example

You run `claude` in a folder.
The program reads your settings, loads your plugins and MCP servers, builds a prompt, and opens a chat.
Run `claude --debug` to see these steps in the log.

## The Big Picture

Source: [How Claude Code Works](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works).

| Piece | Mark | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Native binary | ✅ | One program file for each version, kept in `~/.local/share/claude/versions/` with a launcher at `~/.local/bin/claude` ([Advanced Setup](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/setup)). |
| Bundled code | 🔍 | The program carries its JavaScript inside the file and runs it with the `Bun` runtime. |
| Command parser | 🔍 | The `commander` library builds the tree of commands and flags (see [CLI](Claude-Code-CLI)). |
| Terminal screen | 🔍 | A React-based renderer draws the chat with `ink-box` and `ink-text` elements. |
| Model loop | ✅ | Gather context, act, check the result, and repeat (see [Turn Pipeline](Claude-Code-Turn-Pipeline)). |
| Tools | ✅ | File, search, shell, web, and agent tools (see [Tools](Claude-Code-Tools)). |
| Extensions | ✅ | Hooks, skills, plugins, MCP, subagents, and mods (see [Plugins](Claude-Code-Plugins) and [Hooks](Claude-Code-Hooks)). |
| Feature flags | 🔍 | The program asks a flag service (GrowthBook) which experiments are on for you. |
| Telemetry | ✅ | OpenTelemetry export is off until you set it up ([Monitoring](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage)). |
| Session store | ✅ | Transcripts live under `~/.claude/projects` (see [Sessions and Storage](Claude-Code-Sessions-And-Storage)). |

## Where It Runs

The docs list these places: the terminal, the desktop app, IDE extensions, `claude.ai/code`, Remote Control, Slack, and CI.
All of them run the same loop.
The code can run on your machine, in the cloud, or on your machine under remote control.
Source: [How Claude Code Works](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/how-claude-code-works#environments-and-interfaces).

The env var `CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT` names the host.
The program sets it when the host did not.
The docs show some of the values as `app.entrypoint` in [Monitoring](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage).

| Value | Mark | Set when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `cli` | ✅ | You start `claude` in a terminal. |
| `sdk-cli` | ✅ | You use print mode (`-p`). |
| `sdk-ts`, `sdk-py`, `claude-vscode` | ✅ | An SDK or the VS Code extension starts the program. |
| `mcp` | 🔍 | You run `claude mcp serve`. |
| `claude-code-github-action` | 🔍 | The env var `CLAUDE_CODE_ACTION` is set. |
| `local-agent`, `claude-desktop`, `remote` | 🔍 | A host app sets it. |

## Processes

| Process | Mark | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Main process | ✅ | One for each interactive or print session. |
| Supervisor (`claude daemon`) | ✅ | Runs background sessions so they live on after you close the terminal ([Agent View](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-view)). |
| Subagent | ✅ | A separate loop with its own context window (see [Subagents](Claude-Code-Subagents)). |
| Hook command | ✅ | A child process for each command hook. |
| MCP server | ✅ | A child process or a remote connection (see [MCP](Claude-Code-MCP)). |
| Search helper | ✅ | A bundled `ripgrep`, unless `USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP=0` ([Environment Variables](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/env-vars)). |

The supervisor starts on demand and exits when the last client leaves.
Its files are `~/.claude/daemon.json` and `~/.claude/daemon.log`.

## Startup Steps

Set `CLAUDE_CODE_PROFILE_STARTUP` (🔍) to print the time of each step, such as `[+12.3ms]`.
The order below comes from the bundle.

| Step | Mark | What happens |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Start | 🔍 | The process sets its entry point and builds the command tree. |
| Device settings | 🔍 | Reads device-management settings and the keychain at the same time. |
| Project root | 🔍 | Checks `--project-config-root`, which must be an absolute local folder. |
| Init | 🔍 | Loads config, opens storage, starts the feature flag fetch, and starts the fetch of managed settings. |
| Client data | 🔍 | Loads a signed configuration document if `--client-data-url` or `CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_DATA_URL` is set. |
| Log sinks | 🔍 | Sets the process title to `claude` and starts the log and telemetry sinks. |
| Plugin folders | 🔍 | Reads `--plugin-dir`, `--plugin-dir-no-mcp`, and `--plugin-url`. |
| Migrations | 🔍 | Runs settings migrations. |
| Managed settings | 🔍 | Reads policy settings and refuses a version below the minimum. |
| Plugin early start | 🔍 | Starts plugin install and load early. |
| Main action | 🔍 | Starts telemetry, starts `SessionStart` hooks (not on resume), checks forced login, and builds the app state. |
| MCP connect | 🔍 | Connects MCP servers, then the `claude.ai` connectors. |
| Print mode | 🔍 | Runs the turn and writes the output. |
| Interactive mode | 🔍 | Draws the screen and waits for input. |

`SessionStart` and `Setup` hooks run before the session MCP servers are ready.
So an `mcp_tool` hook cannot run in them ([Hooks Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks)).
